name: mizan-platform
description: Mizan - multi-tenant, offline-capable business management platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mizan/shared && npm run build -w @mizan/backend && npm run build -w @mizan/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @mizan/shared && npm run test -w @mizan/backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @mizan/backend --if-present && npm run lint -w @mizan/frontend --if-present
